coran.intro: Reading (qāʿida), memorisation (hifẓ) and Quran player. Riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim, exact Tanzil text.
coran.hifz_texte: Notebooks E1 (children) and N1 (adults): yearly plan, three tracks every day (new, recent, old), reviews at D+1, D+2, D+3, D+7, D+14, D+30, practice validation by a parent. The teacher remains the only judge; no ijāza.
coran.lecteur_1: choice of reciter (only recitations under written licence);
coran.lecteur_3: repeat a verse or a range N times, with a “my turn” pause;
coran.lecteur_5: download by surah to listen offline.
coran.lecteur_licence: No audio without a licence: the player will be ready and voices added once the rights are secured.
coran.qaida_texte: Series qc1 to qc3: syllables, reading rules and tajwid.
sciences.intro: Creed, fiqh (Mālikī school), life of the Prophet ﷺ, hadith and adab — the books of the Religion series.
sciences.re_texte: Levels re1 to re5: creed, sīra, prophets, fiqh, adab, supplications, hadith; practice log signed by a parent (never graded).
sciences.ra_texte: Levels ra1 to ra4, each published once frozen (the demo shows ra1 and ra2 as a preview): excerpts from Mālikī works, hadiths with their verified reference, case studies, tables, calculations.
sciences.fidelite: Everything shown comes from the books, exactly as written: the app adds no religious content.
ecriture.trace_texte: With a finger or a stylus: I trace over the dots, trace on the light letter, then write alone. The app checks the direction (right to left), the lane and the dots, and never gives a grade.
ecriture.en_attendant: The paper exercise book remains the main way to write: the app guides the movement, and the parent ticks “done in the book” in the lesson.
lectures.texte: Small graded books for each level: illustrated pages, foldable translation, “I understand”, “My words” and the “I read this book” stamp. Each booklet is offered after the lesson where the learner met its words; keep it on the device to read it without network.

gar.intro: What we promise, and how it is checked.
gar.contact: A question about these guarantees? Ask the school or the AWFORM team.
gar.coran_titre: The Quran, exact to the sign
gar.coran: The Quran text comes only from the Tanzil reference text (riwāya Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim). It is never retyped or corrected automatically.
gar.coran_preuve: Check: every verse of the books is compared byte for byte at each import; the hifẓ notebook, the reader and the tutor are tested the same way.
gar.hadiths: A hadith is quoted with its number only if it is in the register with the status “verified”. An unverified number is removed before reaching the phone.
gar.hadiths_preuve: Check: hadith register and automatic tests of the masking.
gar.ia: The tutor never writes the Quran, quotes no hadith outside the register and never gives religious rulings: it passes the question to the teacher. No free text before 13; for a child or teen, nothing without the parent's agreement.
gar.ia_preuve: Check: 1,081 “trap” tests and a fake malicious tutor, all blocked; the AI stays off until these tests are passed with the real model.
gar.voix: Recordings stay on the phone and are erased after 7 days. A family can choose to send one to the class teacher: encrypted, listened to by the teacher only, erased after a few days, deletable at any time. Never used to train an AI.
gar.voix_preuve: Check: sent only with the family's agreement (parent code for a child), encryption tested, access refused to any other account, automatic erasure; no other program reads the audio.
gar.traceurs: No advertising, no third-party advertising or analytics tracker. Fonts and content are served by AWFORM.
gar.traceurs_preuve: Check: browser security policy that forbids external scripts.
gar.enfants: No streak to lose, no ranking, no virtual currency, no night notification, no faces in illustrations. The most protective settings are the defaults.
gar.enfants_preuve: Check: the parent sees the state of each protection (My account → Children's protections).
gar.recompenses: Only symbolic rewards (stamp, star, milestone): never random, never for sale, never compared.
gar.recompenses_preuve: Check: no shop or lottery in the app.
gar.paiement: Payment happens on the provider's secure page (card, mobile money, PayPal). AWFORM never sees your card. The free trial asks for no payment method.
gar.paiement_preuve: Check: no card field in the app; payment messages are signed and verified.
gar.resiliation: My account → My subscription → “Stop the renewal”. Your rights last until the end of the paid period.
gar.donnees: No surname or email address for a child. Export and deletion of all your data from My account. Hosting planned in the European Union.
gar.donnees_preuve: Check: export and deletion tested; pseudonyms only.
gar.hors_ligne: A downloaded lesson works without network; your answers are sent when the network is back, with nothing lost or counted twice.

classe.reserve: This space is reserved for the class teacher.
classe.protection: Children's data: visible to you only, the teacher of this class (not other teachers, not the app administration). Every export and certificate is logged.
classe.confirmer_cc_partiel: I confirm issuing it: recitations or written work were not entered (partial continuous assessment).
classe.niveau_requis: First choose the book used by the class (Pupils and groups tab).
classe.aucun_groupe: No group: the whole class works together.
classe.code_familles: Code for families who use the app: {code}. The parent enrols the child.
classe.prenom_initiale: First name and initial (e.g. Awa D.)
classe.eleve_retire: Pupil removed from the class (results erased; certificates already issued stay in the register).
classe.minimisation: Enter the minimum: first name and initial. No date of birth or contact details are asked. The school collects the families' consent.
classe.devoirs_aide: Lessons and passages: ticked automatically when the pupil does them in the app; you can always tick or untick. Little books and paper class: tick by hand. The pupil never sees "late".
classe.tableau_aide: Marks in %; *: continuous assessment from progress checks only (recitations and productions not entered). Decision per the books' rules: final mark = 60% exam + 40% continuous assessment; 80 very good, 70 good, 60 fairly good; exam at least 50/100. You remain the sole judge.
classe.saisie_aide: Copy the marks of the book's progress checks and exam (out of 20 or 25); leave empty what has not been taken yet. Your entries take precedence over app results.
classe.certificat_aide: Level certificate (book templates) when the decision allows it; hifẓ attestation for a validated recitation. Neither is an ijāza.
classe.nom_complet: Full name as it should appear (optional)
classe.modele_a_valider: Text template to be validated by the pedagogical management.
classe.imprime_note: Teacher's working document, not to be displayed.
classe.champ_naissance: Date of birth (on the certificate only)

act.enseigner: I teach a letter to my parent
act.racines: Build a word from its root
rac.titre: Build a word from its root
rac.intro: A three-consonant root + a pattern (ف ع ل) = a word. Roots, patterns and words come from your books — never made up.
rac.question: Which plural does it build?
rac.bravo: Yes! The consonants {racine} stay in the same order.
rac.essaie: Not yet: keep the three root consonants in order, then add the letters of the pattern.
rac.fini: {n, plural, one {# word built} other {# words built}}. Well done!
rac.aucun: This activity opens with the Adults level 2 book (lesson 12, broken plurals).
ensl.titre: I teach a letter to my parent
ensl.intro: Choose a letter you can write on your own and teach it to your parent. Your parent ticks what they saw.
ensl.aucune_lettre: First write a letter on your own (step 3 of tracing), then come back here:
ensl.choisir: Which letter do you want to teach me?
ensl.enfant_montre: Show the letter in your book.
ensl.enfant_nomme: Say its name and its sound.
ensl.enfant_trace: Trace it in the air with your finger, starting from the right place.
ensl.enfant_mot: Say a word from your lesson that has this letter.
ensl.parent_titre: For the parent: I tick what my child taught me
ensl.parent_nomme: They told me its name and its sound.
ensl.parent_trace: They traced it the right way.
ensl.parent_mot: They gave me a word that has it.
ensl.bravo: Well done {nom}: you became the teacher!
ensl.rien_garde: Nothing is saved or sent: it is a moment just between you.
envoi.titre: Send my recitation to my teacher
envoi.garanties: You (or your parent) decide. The recording is encrypted, only your class teacher can listen to it, it is erased after a few days and never used to train an artificial intelligence. You can delete it at any time.
envoi.accord_texte: To send a recitation, your agreement is needed first (for a child: the parent's, with their code). You can withdraw it in “My account”: what was sent is then erased.
envoi.accord: I allow sending to the class teacher
envoi.ok: Sent: your teacher will be able to listen to it.
envoi.aucun_local: First record your recitation of a passage (“Record myself” button).
ecoute.aide: Sent by families' choice, encrypted, erased after {n} days (class setting). Only you can listen to them; the mark goes into the pupil's notebook.
libre.en_attente: The teacher has not marked it yet.
libre.aide_enseignant: Answers to the open exercises of the books, sent by the families of enrolled pupils. Choose an assessment; the comment is optional (600 characters). The family sees your marking.
projection.aide: Shows a lesson in large print on the board (projector, screen): the pupil's book, one part at a time, without any pupil data. Use the arrow keys to move on.
epreuve.envoyee: paper sent; the mark comes when the teacher closes the test
epreuve.a_revoir: To make progress, review these lessons:
epreuve.consignes: Test marked out of {bareme}, open until {date}. One paper only: check before sending. Answers are not marked straight away.
epreuve.ecoute_adulte: The adult reads the word aloud; choose what you hear.
epreuve.hors_application: This exercise is done in the workbook or with the teacher.
epreuve.confirmer: Send the paper? It can no longer be changed.
epreuve.copie_envoyee: Paper sent. Well done for your work!
epreuve.aide_enseignant: Open a progress check (marked out of 20) or the exam (out of 100) of the class level. Papers are marked by the server for automatic exercises; add the part done outside the app (reading, unseen text, dictation). Below 8/20, lessons to review are suggested to the family. You remain the sole judge.
epreuve.copies: {n, plural, =0 {no papers} one {# paper} other {# papers}}
epreuve.fermer_confirmer: Close the test? No more papers will be accepted and families will see the mark.
epreuve.non_prepares_aide: Texts from the book to read or hand out on the test day; they are never sent to pupils.

rec.aide_ens: Session in front of the teacher: the app draws the passages from the booklet (3 from the core, one more for the extended track), the pupil adds one of their choice. You enter the counts; the mark is computed with the booklet's scale. Never an ijāza, no ranking.
